items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 205:1
items.html: The emergence from the Einayim means the coupling made there in the openings of the eyes, which brought out the ten Sefirot of Nekudim in their measure. And the matter of the ascent of the light was before this, meaning that the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body, and the light departed from the vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward; and likewise the ascent of the coupling Malchut to the openings of the eyes, which brought out the ZON outside the head. And at this time the fall of the vessels from the Chazeh and downward of the points of SAG was made, to the aspect of the empty void beneath the feet of AK. And afterwards the coupling was made in the openings of the eyes, and the circles and the direct [lights] of the smallness of the Nekudim came out, and they returned the vessels from the Chazeh and downward to their former place, but in the aspect of an empty void, empty of all light, because of the power of the conclusion in the Parsa, which holds back the upper light from passing to them, as is known. (Items 2 and 3).
